description: Generate types for a JSON sample in TypeScript, Go (with json tags), Python (Pydantic), Java (records with Jackson), C# (System.Text.Json), Kotlin (kotlinx.serialization) or Rust (serde). Optional and nullable fields are worked out from every item in arrays.

json.description: A JSON sample, such as an API response.

rootName.description: Name of the top-level type; Root by default.

name: json_to_types
title: Generate types from JSON
